svg.text: End-to-end architecture — every component below exists in the implementation
React 18 · App Router · Tailwind · Framer Motion
Jetpack Compose · Room · CameraX · ML Kit
agents · analytics · approvals · artifacts · audit · auth
chat · documents · equipment · health · jobs · knowledge
local inference only — no external model calls
graph query wired to agent tool path
fault injection · sensor disable · line block
UNAVAILABLE — every sandbox_command returns ACTION BLOCKED
make: install · run · web · test · check
All processing, storage and inference occur inside this boundary. No external model provider is called.
